baseline: CHANNEL_250_001: existing channel-only score, replayed as a diagnostic

walk_forward_folds.role: descriptive evaluation; first full channel history

trials.description: Annual expanding Ridge lambda=1 on exactly channel_position_250 and volume_change_1d

feature_definitions.channel_position_250: At signal date t: 2*(split-safe Close(t-1)-min(split-safe Low(t-251:t-2)))/(max(split-safe High(t-251:t-2))-min(split-safe Low(t-251:t-2)))-1. Requires all 250 observations, maps historical High to +1 and Low to -1, and does not clip out-of-range values.
feature_definitions.volume_change_1d: At signal date t: split-safe raw Volume(t-1)/split-safe raw Volume(t-2)-1. Missing, nonfinite or nonpositive volume produces missing feature.
feature_definitions.corporate_actions: Uses raw OHLCV and dated AdjustmentFactor event multipliers cumulatively within listing segments. No retrospectively adjusted OHLCV level is used.
feature_definitions.missing_values: Training requires finite target and both features; inference imputes missing values with each fold's mature-Train means. Scaling uses each fold's mature-Train mean and standard deviation.

model: Annual expanding-window Ridge regression on daily centered cross-sectional percentile target rank, exactly two features, unpenalized intercept.

selection_rule.primary: Descriptive Train-only comparison. No selection because all Train periods are previously seen.
